decision.reason: The candidate passed native X11 rendering, input, scaling, handles, parented picker creation, embedded fonts, and synthetic accessibility-tree probes. OpenGL returned every capture in the selected matrix and used less memory than the tested wgpu path.
decision.scope: This selects the toolkit for the Linux standalone milestone. It does not lock Windows or macOS embedding and does not promote the spike into product architecture.

native_picker.reason: The XDG picker opened with the native parent contract. Its desktop portal is outside the X11 driver's control on this Wayland host, so unattended selection/cancel was not claimed.
